mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.episode_id, s.scene_number, s.location, s.time_description, s.summary, s.content, s.sort_order, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM manga_project_script_scene s INNER JOIN manga_project_script_episode e ON e.id = s.episode_id WHERE e.script_id = #{scriptId} ORDER BY e.sort_order, s.sort_order, s.id
